headline: Contract for South Holyoke Homes Phase 3 certified public accountant services, $81,000, and 2027 MTW Annual Plan submission to HUD.
summary: The main items are a $81,000 contract with AAFCPA for South Holyoke Homes Phase 3 accounting services and approval of the 2027 MTW Annual Plan for submission to HUD. Other items include $214.39 in third quarter write-offs and department reports.
items: Approve submission of the 2027 MTW Annual Plan to HUD
Approve contract award for South Holyoke Homes Phase 3 certified public accountant services to AAFCPA, $81,000
Current issues reports from departments, open for discussion
plain_text:
HOLYOKE HOUSING AUTHORITY REGULAR BOARD MEETING
Thursday, October 8, 2026 at 12:00 PM
475 Maple Street, Holyoke, MA
AGENDA:
1. MINUTES: To approve the minutes of the September 3, 2026 meeting.
2. EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR REPORT
A. RESOLUTIONS:
1. Approve Submission of the 2027 MTW Annual Plan
To approve the MTW Plan as drafted and allow staff to submit to HUD for review and approval.
2. Approve Contract Award for South Holyoke Homes Phase 3 Certified Public Accountant
Services
To approve the award for South Holyoke Homes Phase 3 Certified Public Accountant Services
to AAFCPA, the lowest responsive and responsible quote, in the amount of $81,000.
3. Approve the Third Quarter Write Offs
Approve the Third Quarter Write Offs in the amount of $214.39.
B. CURRENT ISSUES REPORTS (open for discussion)

D. ADJOURN
